### 1. runing time test

#### 1.1 10X genimics

```{r}
exp_mat <- read.table("D:/HSC_Autophagy/Markdown/3.scATFR/ext_data/Nkx2-1_KO/exp_data/Nkx2_1_KO_epi_counts.txt",sep="\t",header=T,row.names=1,check.names=F)
exp_mat_filter <- as.matrix(exp_mat[apply(exp_mat,1,function(x){length(x[which(x>0)])>=10}),])

num_test <- c(200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1500, 2000)
test_time <- pbapply::pblapply(num_test,function(x,mat){
  gname <- sample(x = row.names(mat),size = x,replace = FALSE)
  mat <- mat[gname,]
  time <- c()
  for(i in c("pcor", "pidc", "sclink")){
    st <- proc.time()
    grns <- inferGRNs(x = mat, method= i,ncores=6)
    diff_st <- proc.time()-st
    names(diff_st) <- i
    time[[i]] <- diff_st
  }
  rm(list="grns")
  return(time)
},mat=exp_mat_filter)
names(test_time) <- num_test
saveRDS(test_time,"D:/HSC_Autophagy/Markdown/3.scATFR/ext_data/Nkx2-1_KO/GRNs/PIDC_pcor_SClink_running_time.rds")
test_time_filter <- lapply(test_time,function(x){
  sapply(x,function(y){y[3]})
})

test_time_tab <- do.call(rbind,test_time_filter)
test_time_melt <- reshape2::melt(test_time_tab) %>% filter(Var2 %in% c("pcor.NA","pidc.NA"))
test_time_melt <- reshape2::melt(test_time_tab) %>% filter(Var2 %in% c("pcor.NA","pidc.NA"))


library(ggplot2)
library(ggbreak)
p <- ggplot(test_time_melt,aes(x=Var1,y=value,fill=Var2))+
  geom_bar(stat='identity',position="dodge")
p

```
